newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip in bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip in bearish sentiment.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Monday on sporadic selling and bearish sentiment carried over from last week, traders said.
Expectations that Japan's rubber stocks are set to rise, and weaker overseas prices due to increasing output, dampened market sentiment here, the traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.7 yen to 2.0 yen per kg lower.
Benchmark November was off 0.9 yen at 132.3 yen.
"The market lacked bullish factors. Investors are not expected to start bargain hunting unless rubber prices fall sharply from the current levels," one trader said.
